notes: This vertical slice converts subject 1, run 3 only; it is not the complete dataset.
T1 and T2 meanings are run-dependent. In run 3 they mean executed left and right fist movements.
The full continuous run is retained as one CND trial; events become synchronized impulse features.
No filtering, rereferencing, resampling, artifact rejection, padding, or epoching is performed.
